policy.counting: Union of assigned training and fixed-duty minutes; history duties count on their actual calendar day. No other work assumed.
policy.restAppliesTo: All separate fixed-duty and training intervals, including across horizon boundary; 60 minutes allowed exactly.
policy.recurrence: Fixed elapsed-day deadlines anchored to last completion end, not proposed completion. For every deadline in [horizon.start,horizon.end), emit one occurrence. Must start at or after previous deadline (first: last completion) and finish at or before deadline. Assignments are not completion history.
policy.horizonCarryOver: Report next deadline at/after horizon end as outside_horizon; do not silently count it covered.

scenarios.name: Complete weekly negotiation
scenarios.expectedBehavior: feasible; exactly records[0].expected allocations, 3 baseline collisions, 1 operational violation, zero final hard violations, 7/7 occurrences covered, 540 training person-minutes.

scenarios.name: Shifted operations with interdepartmental counterproposal
scenarios.expectedBehavior: feasible; D2 P3 at Monday08, D3 P3 at Monday10; P1 load60 and P3 load120; other allocations unchanged; 7/7 covered. Compare records[1].expected.

scenarios.name: Expired sole Fire Party Leader
scenarios.expectedBehavior: infeasible, not invalid_input: P6 exists but FPL expired exactly at horizon start; D4 occurrence unmet. No policy relaxation.

scenarios.name: Unavailable sole TAO
scenarios.expectedBehavior: infeasible: P1 unavailable for D1 and D2. Empty availability means no availability, never unrestricted.

scenarios.name: Prior-week rest exactly60
scenarios.expectedBehavior: feasible: prior P1 duty ends Sunday23; D1 Monday00 has exactly60 minutes rest. D2 can remain Monday08; D4 Monday08; D5 Monday10. P1 prior duty does not add to horizon load.

scenarios.name: Prior-week rest just below limit
scenarios.expectedBehavior: infeasible: 0 rest minutes before sole D1 start is less than60; no alternative. One grid step beyond boundary.

scenarios.name: Daily budget exactly120
scenarios.expectedBehavior: feasible with baseline allocations; P1 and P2 Monday duty each120 equals limit.

scenarios.name: Daily budget one minute below demand
scenarios.expectedBehavior: infeasible: P1 must perform two Monday60-minute occurrences;120 exceeds119 regardless of ordering.

scenarios.name: Horizon budget exactly240 and below
scenarios.expectedBehavior: feasible: P2 total240 equals limit. In a second independent run replace limit with239: infeasible because mandatory P2 demand240. Do not relax budget.

scenarios.name: Impossible recurrence deadline
scenarios.expectedBehavior: infeasible: enumerate all7 due occurrences; R-DC@2026-11-15T12:00:00-05:00 cannot finish by12:00 (ends13:00). Other6 have feasible witness. Never omit D7.

scenarios.name: Proven tiny infeasibility
scenarios.expectedBehavior: infeasible after complete enumeration of one joint candidate combination; both requests cannot coexist. Return no purported valid full schedule.

scenarios.name: Zero-budget exhaustion
scenarios.expectedBehavior: exhausted with zero attempted candidate assignments; no infeasibility claim. Budget counts candidate assignment attempts, checked before each attempt; zero prevents the first. Preserve last valid draft. Planning must explicitly retain or reconcile this fixture convention.

scenarios.name: Missing required policy
scenarios.expectedBehavior: invalid_input naming policy.minRestMinutes; preserve draft; restoring60 recovers the baseline result.

scenarios.name: Unknown qualification reference
scenarios.expectedBehavior: invalid_input with unknown qualification reference; restore EOOW then recover baseline. An existing qualification absent from a roster is infeasible instead.

scenarios.name: Malformed duration then correction
scenarios.expectedBehavior: invalid_input naming D1 duration; preserve draft; replace with60 and recover baseline feasible allocations.

scenarios.name: Malformed interval then correction
scenarios.expectedBehavior: invalid_input because end precedes start; restore Monday11 and recover baseline.

scenarios.name: Unknown person reference
scenarios.expectedBehavior: invalid_input naming unknown person; restore P1 and recover baseline.

scenarios.name: Missing qualification on existing person
scenarios.expectedBehavior: infeasible: existing P1 lacks EOOW for D1; TAO still valid for D2. Do not classify well-formed roster as malformed input.

scenarios.name: Qualification expires at drill finish
scenarios.expectedBehavior: feasible: EOOW valid over half-open D1 interval08-09. Expiry08 instead makes D1 infeasible.

scenarios.name: Simulated review invalidation and cancellation
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Load baseline feasible draft revision1; simulate local review -> reviewedRevision1. Edit D5 preferredStart to10 -> revision2 unreviewed. Begin generation then cancel -> cancelled; previous valid allocations retained, stale results discarded, no publication or real approval.

limitations: All names, ship, qualifications, policy numbers, history and operations are invented; no actual SFTRM rules or operational records.
Owner must supply and approve operational fatigue rules, periodicities, qualification semantics and completion history before operational claims.
Synthetic rest60 minutes is intentionally compact for hand-checkable examples and is not operational guidance.

Deterministic feasibility, not global optimization. Expected allocations follow documented request/start/person order; another independently validated solution is feasible but must not be called this exact deterministic result.
Negotiation entries are expected evidence witnesses, not an implementation or canned dialogue to display without computing constraints.
Search-budget and review/cancel semantics are fixture expectations; planning must document any necessary explicit reconciliation before freezing contracts.
No application built or verified here. Host must independently validate and freeze these artifacts.
